title: When the Summer Turns
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
